## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Shree Adithya Catering Service?
No. 27, Oragadam Cross Street, Ambattur, Chennai 600 053 (Mr. Mohanakrishnan).

### What facilities does Shree Adithya Catering Service have?
Marriages, Seemantham, Ear-boring, Birthdays, Gruhapravesam, Upanayanam, Corporate events, Welcome girls, Mehandhi, Tambulam bags, Arthi plates, Seer arrangements, Stage decoration, Melam & band set, Photography, Hall booking.

### Can we change the menu?
Yes. The menu can be changed as you like; the final menu should be given one month before the marriage date.

### Do you arrange more than food?
Yes — welcome girls, mehandhi, tambulam bags, seer items, stage decoration, melam, photography and hall booking.

### How do I book Shree Adithya Catering Service?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98841 01615.
